content:
Here is the recipe JSON:
{
  "recipe_name": "Paneer Masala",
  "ingredients": [
    "250 grams paneer",
    "2 large onions",
    "2 large tomatoes",
    "1 teaspoon cumin seeds",
    "1 teaspoon coriander powder",
    "1 teaspoon garam masala powder",
    "1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder",
    "1/2 teaspoon red chili powder",
    "1/2 teaspoon salt",
    "2 tablespoons butter",
    "2 tablespoons oil",
    "2 cloves garlic",
    "1 inch ginger",
    "2 tablespoons tomato puree",
    "1 tablespoon fenugreek leaves",
    "1 cup water",
    "Fresh cilantro for garnish"
  ],
  "steps": [
    {
      "step_number": 1,
      "instruction": "Heat oil in a pan and saut\u00e9 the onions until they are translucent.",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Use a large pan to saut\u00e9 the onions."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 2,
      "instruction": "Add the cumin seeds, coriander powder, garam masala powder, turmeric powder, and red chili powder. Cook for 1 minute.",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Stir continuously to avoid burning the spices."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 3,
      "instruction": "Add the ginger and garlic and cook for another minute.",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Grate the ginger and garlic for better flavor."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 4,
      "instruction": "Add the tomato puree and cook until the oil separates.",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Use fresh tomatoes for the puree."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 5,
      "instruction": "Add the paneer and cook for 5 minutes.",
      "time": "5 minutes",
      "tip": "Cut the paneer into small cubes for even cooking."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 6,
      "instruction": "Add the water and bring to a boil. Then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.",
      "time": "10 minutes",
      "tip": "Adjust the water according to the desired consistency."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 7,
      "instruction": "Add the butter and fenugreek leaves. Cook for another 2 minutes.",
      "time": "2 minutes",
      "tip": "Use fresh fenugreek leaves for better flavor."
    },
    {
      "step_number": 8,
      "instruction": "Garnish with cilantro and serve hot.",
      "time": "1 minute",
      "tip": "Serve with naan or rice."
    }
  ]
}
how much time will it take
It will take approximately 30-35 minutes to prepare the Paneer Masala recipe.
